verifiedObservedFacts.fact: After the visible first-run fullscreen notice, main menu and How to Play screen were traversed through visible input, the captured run reached the live Cavern Cravers dungeon board with gameplay resources and a populated tactical card grid visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves actual game entry only for the captured validation window.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: A bounded tap on a visible gameplay card changed the captured board composition, producing a clearly observable before/after state transition while remaining in the live dungeon screen.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the directly observed board-state transition is promoted; hidden card resolution, combat, economy and procedural-generation rules are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The package remained alive and foreground after tutorial and gameplay inputs, with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV or ANR marker in the validation window.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves the captured validation window and does not claim indefinite long-run stability.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A first-run tutorial or How to Play screen is a distinct pre-game state and should not be counted as live gameplay entry until the interactive dungeon state is visible.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For RPG QA, preserve separate milestones for tutorial presentation, tutorial exit and first live interactive gameplay state.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The verified dungeon state presents a compact set of actionable gameplay choices, and a successful action immediately changes the visible board state in the same gameplay context.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For a Roblox RPG, make bounded tactical actions produce prompt, legible state feedback without requiring the player to leave the core encounter view.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A gameplay input becomes useful evidence when the before/after frames show a meaningful game-state change and the target process remains foreground and crash-free.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Bind RPG interaction evidence to semantic before/after frames plus process, focus and crash checks.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: A prior probe reached live gameplay but tapped just outside an actionable card and therefore produced no visible change; unchanged output did not prove that the game or interaction system was broken.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: When game entry is visually verified but an input produces no change, distinguish an automation-target miss from a product failure and re-target a directly visible control before judging the game.

allowed: immediate visible feedback after a bounded gameplay action
portable RPG interaction lessons that may inform later Roblox-specific implementation and verification
stillForbidden: treating Android evidence as Roblox runtime evidence
inferring hidden card, combat, economy, procedural-generation or progression formulas
copying game artwork, UI trade dress, names, text or implementation details into a Roblox game
claims about long-run progression, balance or economy not measured by the captured validation window
